item.title: Two Weeks of Claude Breaking and Fixing Staging: The Chaos Loop Behind the Claude Docs Launch
item.description: How the Claude Docs team let Claude stress, break, and repair a production-like staging cluster for about two weeks before launch, which decisions stayed with a human, why the service runs on Rust with minimal dependencies, and what the launch results and inference bill looked like.
